## Rashmi Ladani UI/UX Designer

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

- [rashmiladani6@gmail.com](mailto:rashmiladani6@gmail.com)
- Surat, India
- [GitHub](https://github.com/rashmiladani6-afk)

Seeking an entry-level UI/UX Designer role to utilize my design, creativity, and problem-solving skills in  building  user-friendly  and  visually  engaging digital  experiences while growing professionally in a collaborative environment.

<!-- image -->

## SKILLS

## Web Development

- CSS
- HTML
- JavaScript

## UI/UX (Figma and Canva)

- UX Design
- UI Design
- Wireframing & Prototyping
- Responsive UI Development
- React JS
- User Research
- Material UI / Bootstrap
- User Flow Design
- Design Systems

<!-- image -->

## Professional Experience

UI/UX Designer & React JS Developer, Pixeleyez infotech LLP

## Soft Skills

- Teamwork
- Problem Solving
- Communication

08/2025 - 04/2026 Surat, India

- Created wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs using Figma .
- Designed UI/UX for Grocery and E-commerce Mobile Apps ,  focusing  on intuitive user experience, visual hierarchy, and user-friendly interfaces ( 3 Months Experience ) .
- Developed and maintained a CRM web application using React.js .
- Converted HTML designs into modern, responsive layouts using Tailwind CSS .
- Built  reusable  and  responsive UI  components  for  dashboards  and  web interfaces .
- Improved  application  performance  and  optimized  component  rendering for better usability and responsiveness.
- Applied user-centered  design  principles to  create  visually  engaging  and accessible digital experiences.
- Collaborated  with  designers  and  developers  for feature  implementation, UI improvements, and design consistency .
- Used Git  &  GitHub for version control, project  management,  and collaboration.

[+91 97245 71368](tel:+91 97245 71368)

[Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rashmiladani/)

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

## PROJECTS

## E-Commerce Landing Page Design, Figma | UI/UX Design

- Created intuitive navigation, product sections, promotional banners, and call-to-action areas.
- Designed an e-commerce landing page focused on product showcase and user engagement.
- Developed wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma .
- Improved usability through user-centered design and modern visual aesthetics.

## Portfolio Website

A full-stack responsive portfolio showcasing a carousel/slider landing page and multiple sections, including Projects, Blog, and Contact.

Tech Stack: React.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Material UI

## Fast Food Ordering Website,

Developed a responsive site for a restaurant with functionality to view menu, add to cart, and place dummy orders. Tech Stack: HTML, CSS

<!-- image -->

## EDUCATION

Diploma in Engineering (Computer Science),

Government Polytechnic For Girls, Surat CGPA - 7.21

06/2021 - 04/2024 Surat, India

SSC, P. P . Savani High School

Grade - B

05/2018 - 03/2021 Surat, India

<!-- image -->

## Courses

## Front-End Developer, JBS Institute

- UI Components: Designed and implemented reusable components such as navigation bars, forms, and interactive buttons for learning projects.
- Frontend Development: Built user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript with a focus on semantic structure, responsive layouts, and cross-browser compatibility.
- Responsive Design: Applied Flexbox, CSS Grid, and media queries to ensure mobile-first and device-friendly layouts.
